title: Horizon-inspired Solvane R4: individual review of 100 reference images
scope: Completed image review and selective original technique transfers. Inspection is not implementation of every depicted requirement, commercial-reference parity, a hardware performance result or release approval.

verification.method: Each recovered compressed review file was rehashed and matched against both manifest.json and its assigned individual audit. The original full-resolution source files were not re-downloaded or byte-verified by this consolidation.
verification.original_source_hashes: Retained from the source manifest as provenance only; the per-record field name explicitly distinguishes them from verified compressed-review hashes.

inspection_methods.method: Individually labelled contact sheets; 003, 019, 022 and 023 also inspected at full supplied review resolution.
Five individually labelled sheets; 044 also inspected at full supplied review resolution. Additional road studies examined 016 and 017 at full supplied resolution.
Individually labelled 490-pixel source tiles, five images per sheet; selective use does not certify every depicted detail.
Individually labelled local contact sheets. Supplementary 040-042 records were excluded from consolidation to retain exactly one record per image.

disposition_meanings.partial_technique_transfer: An original material, shading or activity principle is applied; depicted models, scenes and overall fidelity are not claimed.
disposition_meanings.preservation_guidance: Existing material or presentation behavior is deliberately retained; this does not mean the pictured asset was rebuilt.
disposition_meanings.reviewed_not_implemented: The review is complete; no new R4 implementation is attributed to this reference. Specific omitted work is recorded per image.
disposition_meanings.promotional_exclusion: Marketing, peripheral, calendar, specification or illustrated title content is excluded from runtime implementation.

content_limits: Reference photographs, licensed car shapes, logos and commercial entitlements are not copied into the runtime. Still-image observations do not establish measured physics, completed driving trials or hardware FPS.
